svg.title: 2. Tenant context and isolation on every request
svg.text: When the code has a bug
Tenant context: from sign-in to a row in the database, the tenant id is carried, enforced and logged at every hop (pool tier)
context, never from the request body.
Puts it on every log line and metric.
Tenant-scoped data access: the IAM policy decides, not the code
A missing filter asks for PK = TENANT#t-1007 with t-4821 credentials.
DynamoDB returns AccessDeniedException, nothing leaks. The 403 is counted
as CrossTenantDenied (EMF metric). Any value above 0 pages security,
because it is either a bug or someone probing.
Service logs + EMF metrics: tenant_id, tier, operation
CloudTrail data events: role session name = t-4821-documents
So "what did t-4821 do, and what did it cost" is one query.
